content.text: iVH is not a company that simply utilizes ASAM standards.
We are a company that **engineers Verification & Validation (V&V) processes** based on ASAM.
**As the official ASAM partner in Korea,** iVH represents the domestic industry by disseminating ASAM standards and serving as the vital link between global standards and Korean industry.

blocks.title: Building the ASAM Ecosystem in Korea

content.text: To establish ASAM standards within the domestic market,
iVH consistently hosts **ASAM Regional Meetings** and domestic conferences,
building an ecosystem that connects OEMs, Tier-1 suppliers, research institutes, and universities.
Through these initiatives, iVH serves as:

items: A catalyst for raising awareness of the ASAM OpenX family of standards.
A focal point for gathering and synthesizing domestic industrial requirements.

content.text: A strategic gateway for reflecting the voice of the Korean industry in global standards.

blocks.title: From Understanding Standards to Applying Them

content.text: iVH goes beyond merely interpreting standard documentation.
**We apply testing, modeling, and scenario standards directly to industrial engineering practices.**
Our core areas of standardization include:
Rather than limiting these standards to a single domain,
iVH implements them as **practical, ready-to-use verification frameworks**
tailored to the domestic industrial environment, regulatory requirements, and development processes.
While ASAM standards originated in the automotive industry,
**iVH is convinced that their application can extend to the robotics industry and future systems at large.**
iVH is:

items: Based on ASAM-based verification experience accumulated in the automotive sector
To autonomous robots, AMR, smart factories, and complex system domains.

content.text: This is not a simple technology transition, but **an evolution of standard-based verification methodology.**
iVH does not consume ASAM standards as short-term project knowledge.
To elevate the standards of the entire domestic industry,
we conduct **ASAM standard training programs and continuous research activities.**
**Key Activities:**

items: ASAM training for domestic companies and research institutes
Operation of OpenX-based research and study groups
Standard utilization research reflecting domestic requirements

content.text: Through these efforts, iVH ensures that verification is not subordinated to specific projects
but **established as an Engineering Asset**
**that can be accumulated and reused across the entire industry.**
iVH’s ASAM-based Verification & Validation Engineering is not a fixed methodology.
As industries change, we interpret, expand, and evolve the standards.

Standards are not fixed rules,
but a common language that must grow with the industry.
By extending this common language beyond automotive to robotics and future systems,
iVH prepares for the next stage of a verifiable industry.
